desc: Make Every Inch Count. The SureFire SOCOM762-MINI2 delivers big performance levels in a small package optimized for 7.62 mm rifles equipped with 16-inch and longer barrels. It’s compact, measuring just 6.3 inches in length, but it places a premium on efficiency while maintaining the quality synonymous with the SureFire suppressor that dominated the demanding USSOCOM suppressor trials. Our innovative internal baffling significantly decreases back pressure, cyclic rate and gas blowback. The net result is a tremendous reduction in sound and dust signature with virtually undetectable first-round flash and minimal, consistent point-of-impact shift.
